name: Phantasmal Wasps
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting]; Level sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target living creatures in a 5-foot radius
Duration up to 4 rounds
Saving Throw Will disbelief, then Fortitude partial; see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a phantasmal image of a swarm of monstrous wasps. Only the spell’s subjects can see the phantasmal wasps. You see only a vague shape. The targets first get Will saves to recognize the image as unreal. If that save fails, the phantasm touches the subject. The subject suffers 3d6 points of damage and must succeed on a Fortitude save or also suffer 1d6 points of Dexterity damage. This Dexterity damage repeats each round for the spell’s duration; a Fortitude save is permitted each round to negate that round’s Dexterity damage.
